name: Quassel-web
tagline: A web client for Quassel. Note that a Quassel-Core instance is required, we have a container available here.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/quassel-web:version-019bfdc1@sha256:15453e655257907853d02a41903c255f0fd4da8a759f13f73b2573dca2d981ba
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      QUASSEL_CORE: ''
      QUASSEL_PORT: ''
      QUASSEL_HTTPS: ''
      URL_BASE: ''
    ports:
      - target: 64080
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 64443
        published: 64443
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
